CLINICAL FEATURES OF MALE INFERTILITY
Clinical Features
- Vital points in the history: Duration of infertility
- Ability to have erection, penetration and ejaculation Family history of
infertility
- History of systemic disease e.g. diabetes mellitus, hypertension, chronic
liver disease and tuberculosis
- History of sexually transmitted infections and urinary tract infections
- History of genital trauma
- History of surgery: herniorraphy, orchidopexy, urethral surgeries, etc
- Signs
- Gynaecomastia
- Penis: epispadias, hypospadias, penile deformities
- Scrotum: absence of testis, small sized testis, varicocoeles, hard and
irregular epididymis
